name: Shared Binders
description: Share a Dex binder with other people. Each person gets a role — Viewer can look, Contributor can slot cards in and out, Admin can rename, re-cover and re-share. Admins can also turn on a shared group binder for a group, the same way Orbit gives a group its shared directory. Remove the plugin and every binder quietly goes back to being personal.
author: Nucleus
